title: Ransomware Incident Response
story: A ransomware attack has infected multiple systems. Students must contain the attack and begin recovery procedures.

tasks.title: Identify Infected Host
tasks.description: Determine which host shows ransomware activity.
tasks.hint: Look for encryption activity, ransom notes, or suspicious processes.

tasks.title: Isolate System
tasks.description: Remove the infected host from the network.
tasks.hint: Use network controls to quarantine the host.

tasks.title: Analyze Indicators
tasks.description: Collect indicators such as filenames, hashes, domains, and processes.
tasks.hint: Document artifacts linked to the ransomware.

tasks.title: Block Spread
tasks.description: Prevent the ransomware from moving to additional systems.
tasks.hint: Block SMB, malicious IPs, or compromised credentials as needed.

tasks.title: Restore Services
tasks.description: Begin controlled restoration of affected services.
tasks.hint: Restore only after containment and verification.
